items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: I did a piece on the pianist Rene Rosnes not too long ago. Well I wanted to find out what made her tick.

ctx.x: If you got an assignment to write about someone who has been written about a lot, could you envision how you would find your own angle to get at this person?

My own attitude or my own tendency is usually to look at the history. In other words I did a piece on the pianist Rene Rosnes not too long ago. Well I wanted to find out what made her tick. I didn’t actually want to do another puff about her latest record. What editors want often is just don’t talk to her about her record. You know that will please the record company. Well I’d much rather sort of find out what made her the pianist she is in terms of her influences, a little bit of her history and background, and…
Did you ever get an assignment to write liner notes for a recording that you didn’t like?
